image.title: Image to memorise
image.description: Shown to everyone for a few seconds, then hidden.

viewSeconds.title: Viewing time (seconds)
viewSeconds.description: How long the image stays visible before the question appears.

question.title: Question
question.description: Asked after the image is hidden, e.g. "How many red cups were on the table?"

options.title: Answer options
options.description: Between 2 and 6 options; shown lettered A, B, C…

correctIndex.title: Correct option (position)
correctIndex.description: 0 for the first option, 1 for the second, and so on.
